title: DomainProbeProfile
description: Identity and metadata for a domain-specific probe profile. Not a gate authority — profile name alone does not establish scope approval.

profile_id.description: Stable machine identifier for this profile.

profile_hash.description: Content hash of the canonical form of this profile (excluding this field). Establishes immutable identity.

tool_id.description: The tool this profile applies to.

probe_library_version.description: Version of the Contradictor probe library this profile was authored against.
